subject: gate:trivy
value: Scans the current workspace for high and critical vulnerabilities and misconfigurations before a harness command runs. Secret scanning is off (slowest scanner, lowest download risk); dependency and build directories are skipped so the walk stays fast, and Windows delete-pending entries (files and directories whose names start with '~') are skipped so the walk cannot crash on them.
